query: What praise and complaints appear in IMDb reviews?

per_column.name: overall_stance
per_column.rationale: Positive/negative/mixed overall valence is a summary of the whole praise-and-complaints concept, not a constitutive aspect of it. It restates the target rather than decomposing it.

per_column.name: acting_assessment
per_column.rationale: Acting is a specific film aspect that reviews praise or criticise, i.e., a genuine part of what audience praise/complaints are about.

per_column.name: writing_script_assessment
per_column.rationale: Writing/script is a distinct evaluable aspect that reviewers praise or complain about.

per_column.name: directing_assessment
per_column.rationale: Directing is a distinct constitutive aspect of the praise/complaint content.

per_column.name: technical_production_assessment
per_column.rationale: Technical/production quality is a legitimate distinct facet audiences praise or criticise.

per_column.name: story_plot_assessment
per_column.rationale: Story/plot is a core aspect of praise and complaints in film reviews.

per_column.name: pacing_engagement_assessment
per_column.rationale: Pacing/engagement is a distinct aspect of the viewing experience that is praised or criticised.

per_column.name: specific_praised_element
per_column.rationale: This aggregates the single most-praised element across categories (performance, visuals, premise, etc.), overlapping heavily with the per-aspect assessment facets. It re-summarises praise rather than adding a non-overlapping constitutive aspect.

per_column.name: specific_complained_element
per_column.rationale: Mirror of the above for complaints; its values (script, acting, plot logic, pacing, production) duplicate the dedicated per-aspect facets, adding overlap rather than a new aspect.

per_column.name: audience_recommendation
per_column.rationale: Whether the reviewer recommends the film is a downstream conclusion/consequence of praise and complaints, not itself an aspect of what is praised or complained about.

judge.rationale: Six columns are true meronymic facets, carving the praise/complaints concept into distinct evaluable film aspects (acting, writing, directing, technical/production, story, pacing) that together cover most of the concept's constitutive dimensions. However mutual exclusivity is weakened: specific_praised_element and specific_complained_element collapse the same aspects (performance, script, plot, pacing, production) into aggregate columns, materially overlapping the dedicated per-aspect facets. overall_stance is a restatement of the whole, and audience_recommendation is a downstream consequence rather than a facet. Exhaustiveness of the genuine facet set is fairly high but not complete (e.g., no explicit facet for emotional impact or genre/tone beyond the aggregates).
